title: Stay with the unfamiliar word for a little longer
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Locate the distinction — Ask what work the unfamiliar term does in the argument.; Build a small example — Connect the definition to a case you can inspect.; Mark the boundary — Add a non-example and a claim the term does not imply.; Return to the passage — Check whether the original conclusion is now clearer..
